{{Top|leg}}
'''The Change''' was a three-month portion of an [[X'Ting]]'s life-cycle. Over this time, the [[Gender/Legends|gender]] of the individual changed; the switch was followed by an physiological and emotional time of trauma. During this time in their life, wealthy X'Ting would ease their trauma by using [[viptiel]].
